authors: Bob Eaton, Jim Kornelson, SIL International
description: Libraries and merge modules for core encoding converter functionality.
releaseNotes: Includes managed DLLs (for including in projects as nuget artifacts) in the .\lib\<tfm>\... folders (net462, net48, net9.0, net9.0-windows, netstandard2.0), and other managed and non-managed (read: non-nuget) resources that optionally may be manually added to projects or at least in installers in the .\runtimes\... folder -- including plugin definitions, tlb, and exe files for both Win32/x86 and x64. Some of the resources are also included in various merge modules in the .\installer\MergeModules... folder
